sql: select e.state, ed.deployment_key, ed.kind, ed.stage, eda.strategy_tag, ee.epoch_number, ed.twin_of_deployment_id, ed.started_at::text as started from experiments e join experiment_versions ev on ev.experiment_id=e.id join experiment_epochs ee on ee.version_id=ev.id join experiment_deployments ed on ed.epoch_id=ee.id join experiment_deployment_arms eda on eda.deployment_id=ed.id where e.key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity' and ed.ended_at is null order by ed.id
